name: Todoist: Planner & Calendar (Google Play)

motion.capture_method: Real store listing recorded by Weles WSession 0.5.8 on the Stado-pinned charless-mac-mini dedicated host; Weles Chromium 147.0.7727.108-weles.1; direct canonical navigation, measured scrolls, humanized selection attempt, reversal, and Playwright WebM recording. No browser was launched on the operator computer.
Downloaded without browser from the publisher trailer linked as this app listing’s video by Google Play; YouTube delivery was remuxed to MP4.

interactions.name: Open listing
interactions.trigger: Navigate to the canonical store URL.
interactions.response: The store renders the product header and acquisition context.
interactions.feedback: The product name, icon, rating/context, and listing chrome become visible.
interactions.cancellation: Leave or close the page before interacting.
interactions.failure: A network or store response can prevent the header from rendering.
interactions.recovery: Reload the canonical URL and wait for the header state.

interactions.name: Confirm load
interactions.trigger: Pause for two seconds after navigation.
interactions.response: Deferred artwork and listing modules finish rendering.
interactions.feedback: Stable header and media geometry confirm readiness.
interactions.cancellation: Navigate away before the settle interval ends.
interactions.failure: Unsettled or blank media remains visibly incomplete.
interactions.recovery: Wait for the page to settle before continuing.

interactions.name: Scroll to media
interactions.response: The viewport moves from the header toward the screenshot or preview shelf.
interactions.feedback: The media region replaces part of the header in the viewport.
interactions.failure: A scroll that is too short leaves the media target below the fold.
interactions.recovery: Continue a measured downward scroll until the shelf is visible.

interactions.name: Select preview
interactions.trigger: Activate the visible target named Screenshot.
interactions.response: The store activates the visible screenshot media control.
interactions.cancellation: Remain on the shelf, dismiss selected media, or reverse to the prior scroll position.
interactions.failure: No selection failure is observed; the later scroll overshoot supplies the recorded failure route.
interactions.recovery: Dismiss or leave the selected media context by continuing the reversible listing path.

interactions.name: Continue to details
interactions.response: Description, metadata, ratings, privacy, or data-safety content enters the viewport.
interactions.feedback: The viewport changes continuously with the scroll.
interactions.cancellation: Scroll upward to return to media.
interactions.failure: The target detail can remain below the fold on a taller listing.

interactions.name: Overshoot target
interactions.trigger: Scroll downward by 1800 pixels after reaching details.
interactions.response: The viewport moves beyond the intended media/detail target.
interactions.feedback: The target shelf is no longer visible and later listing sections appear.
interactions.cancellation: Stop the gesture before its end.
interactions.failure: The intended inspection target is overshot.
interactions.recovery: Reverse direction with an upward scroll.

interactions.name: Recover position
interactions.trigger: Scroll upward by 2400 pixels after the overshoot.
interactions.response: The viewport returns toward the media and detail region.
interactions.feedback: Previously seen modules re-enter the viewport in reverse order.
interactions.failure: A partial reverse can stop short of the target.
interactions.recovery: Continue upward until the recognizable shelf returns.

interactions.name: Backtrack to header
interactions.trigger: Scroll upward by a further 2400 pixels.
interactions.response: The listing returns to its product header and acquisition context.
interactions.feedback: The original product header is visible again.
interactions.cancellation: Stop at any intermediate listing section.
interactions.failure: Large pages may require another upward gesture.
interactions.recovery: Repeat the upward gesture until the header is restored.

journey.actor: Prospective mobile-app user evaluating a store listing before installation.
journey.goal: Discover Todoist: Planner & Calendar (Google Play), inspect its product media and listing details, recover from a navigation overshoot, and return to the product header ready for the next store decision.
prerequisites: Network access to the canonical Apple App Store or Google Play listing.
A browser capable of rendering the listing, scrolling, and exposing store controls.
No authentication or purchase is required for this observed inspection path.

steps.system_response: The store resolves the product listing and renders its header.

steps.user_action: Wait for deferred artwork and modules to settle.
steps.system_response: The listing reaches a stable, inspectable header state.
The product screenshot/preview region enters the viewport.

steps.user_action: Attempt to activate the target named Screenshot.
steps.system_response: Weles reports clicked button: Screenshot; the visible screenshot control is activated.
steps.evidence: media/listing-state-03.png and the selection segment of media/listing-interaction.webm

steps.system_response: The listing advances to descriptive and trust metadata.
The intended media/detail target is overshot and later sections appear.
Earlier media/detail modules return in reverse order.
The original product header returns, completing the discovery-to-open inspection loop.

failure_route: The Screenshot selection succeeds; no failure is observed for that interaction.
A subsequent large downward scroll intentionally overshoots the media/detail target and later listing sections replace it.
recovery_route: Continue from or dismiss the selected media context using the reversible listing path.
Reverse direction by 2400 pixels after the later overshoot to recover the media/detail region.
Continue upward by 2400 pixels to restore the original listing header.
journey.completion_evidence: media/listing-state-07.png and the final segment of media/listing-interaction.webm show the product header restored after the observed failure and recovery route.

observations: The product name and listing content are visibly rendered at the opening state.
Continuous scrolling preserves context and can be reversed without a modal trap.
The Screenshot selection attempt produced the explicit Weles result clicked button: Screenshot, rather than silently activating another element.
The recording retains stable visual feedback after each navigation action.
unknowns: Screen-reader announcements and accessible-name completeness were not audited with assistive technology.
Keyboard-only focus order and focus visibility were not exercised.
Caption availability for every upstream preview and autoplay policy are not established.
Reduced-motion preferences and nonanimated equivalents were not exercised.

evidence_gaps: accessibility never measured against the product
